summary: SlotNow iter43 tested. Backend: 9/9 executed tests pass in test_iter43.py (2 skipped by design — one requires OTP dispatch which spec forbids, one requires an available booking slot which the seeded hospital shift didn't expose). Regression: iter40+iter41+iter42 = 46/47 pass; the 1 failure in test_hospital_staff_schedule.py is pre-existing (409: 'You already have a booking with this provider in this shift') caused by leftover test-state, unrelated to iter43 changes. Frontend: all 4 iter43 UI surfaces verified end-to-end — ProviderServices photo upload (input, label, preview, thumbnail on new card), Home wait-history widget (avg=18, hint 'Try booking around 18:00'), MyBookings past pills (4 pills, correct 'Waited X min beyond slot' text, correct emerald/amber colour bands), BookSlot picker (avatar fallback for seed doctors without photo, service photo thumbnails render when photo is set).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~3191 lines — recommend splitting by feature (bookings, providers, wait-history, queue) into routers to stay under 700-line target.

Photo field is stored as raw data URL (base64). Individual services can therefore push Mongo document size close to the 16MB cap if many photos are stored per provider; consider a size guard (e.g. reject >~250KB data URLs server-side) similar to the guard used for review photos.
/customers/me/wait-history uses IST-anchored sched_dt vs UTC completed_at — logic is correct but relies on IST module-level constant; add a unit test to guard against future TZ regressions.
waited_min enrichment loop in _enrich_bookings recomputes scheduled datetime per booking; fine now but if bookings list grows large per user consider a projection-only path or caching.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — 2 TEST_ services were created and deleted during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter43 backend + frontend fully green. Seeded 4 completed bookings for customer 9000009999 (10/8/30/25 waited-min at 18:00/18:00/10:00/10:00 IST across Jul 23/26/29/31 2026) are load-bearing for the Home widget and MyBookings pills — do NOT modify them. New endpoint GET /customers/me/wait-history and Service.photo (data URL) field are the only new API surface. The one skipped PUT-completed test can be re-enabled if a fresh provider account with real slots is created; the 3 seeded rows already exercise the enrichment path (waited_min: int) so coverage is not lost. Pre-existing failure in test_hospital_staff_schedule.py::TestBookingWithStaff::test_booking_valid_shift_for_staff is due to stateful test data (409 conflict), not an iter43 regression.
